name: publish_stories
doc: Creates one Azure Boards work item per selected story.

name: reload_doc_page_from_wiki
doc: Replaces a document's body with the page as the wiki holds it now — the "reload" answer to a publish conflict.

name: review_work_item
doc: Runs one stage of the review against zero or more repositories.

name: save_work_item_review
doc: Saves a review session under its own id, overwriting the previous save of that same session.

name: set_story_batch_answers
doc: The answers to this batch's open questions, as the modal edits them.

name: set_story_batch_feature_project
doc: Which of those repositories the `.feature` file is written into.

name: set_story_batch_instructions
doc: The extra instructions the *next* generation runs with — "más detalle en los errores", "sepáralo por módulo".

name: set_story_batch_verify_projects
doc: The repositories whose code this batch's criteria are checked against.

name: story_batch_board_states
doc: Reads every published story of a batch back from its board and keeps each one's state on the story — what the team has started, finished or closed since the publish, without opening the board.

name: story_batch_prompt
doc: The prompt a set's stories came out of.

name: story_source_document
doc: A PDF, Word or other office document on disk, as Markdown — the «Documento» source.

name: story_source_url
doc: A web page (or a document behind a link) as Markdown, its main content only — the «Página web» source.

name: update_story_on_board
doc: Writes a published story's current draft over its work item — title, narrative and description, acceptance criteria, estimate — on Azure Boards, Jira or monday alike.

name: verify_stories
doc: Checks the batch's acceptance criteria against the code of every repository it points at.

name: write_story_feature_file
doc: Writes the batch's `.feature` file into the one repository chosen to hold it.

name: team_answer
doc: Answers a question a member or the lead asked the user.

name: team_claim
doc: Marks every item that may start now as running and returns what to run.

name: team_control
doc: `pause`, `resume`, `abort`, or per item `retry:<id>` / `skip:<id>`.

name: team_decide
doc: Answers whatever a gated run waits for.

name: team_delete_run
doc: Deletes a run with its tasks, its clean worktrees and the branches with nothing of their own.

name: team_item_terminal
doc: Records the terminal session an item runs in (so the view can open it).

name: team_note
doc: A note from the user to a member, the lead or everyone — delivered with their next item.

name: team_pump
doc: Moves a run from any window: the runner claims what is ready.

name: team_run_artifacts
doc: The artifacts a run's members published, newest first — the record the run's views draw.

name: team_run_metrics
doc: Spend per member, who talks to whom, and the alerts the live view shows.

name: team_run_policy
doc: Edits a running run's own copy of the policy — a budget raised, the parallelism or the communication rules changed from the live view — without touching the team.

name: team_settle
doc: One item's turn is over.

name: team_start
doc: Starts a run: copies the roster and the policy, makes one integration worktree per repository off its target branch, and seeds the graph — the lead's first plan, or the team's fixed plan.

name: add_bench_tab
doc: A new, empty tab.

name: add_workspace_terminal
doc: Adds a terminal to the bench and starts its shell.

name: agent_cli_effort_support
doc: Whether [`agent_cli_routing_args`] can give `provider`'s terminal session a reasoning level.

name: agent_cli_routing_args
doc: The arguments that point an agent CLI started in a terminal at `model` and `effort` — the «Worktrees» rail's «Nuevo agente».

name: agent_launch_files
doc: The files an agent CLI started from the «Worktrees» rail is given: - **`--settings`** for Claude Code: its status hooks, each one a `cf hook claude <event>`.

name: clear_workspace_terminals
doc: Empties the bench: every shell killed, every transcript forgotten.

name: list_shell_profiles
doc: Every shell the terminal can open with — detected built-ins plus the user's own profiles.

name: list_workspace_terminals
doc: Called every time the panel opens, which is what makes "closed but still running" work: the app may have been up the whole time with the shells alive behind a shut panel, and this is how the panel fin

name: open_terminal
doc: `profile_id` is the id of a profile from [`list_shell_profiles`]; omitting it opens the configured default.

name: remove_bench_tab
doc: Closes a tab: every shell in it killed, every transcript in it forgotten.

name: remove_workspace_terminal
doc: Removes one terminal: its shell is killed and its row and output are forgotten.

name: resume_workspace_terminal
doc: Starts a shell for a row that has none — the restart case, and the "it exited and I want it back" case.

name: set_bench_layout
doc: Records a tab's pane arrangement.

name: terminal_agent_states
doc: Every terminal with an agent in it, as the rail draws it — for a window that just opened.

name: terminal_foreground
doc: What a terminal is busy with — the program in its foreground other than the shell — so closing its tab can ask first.

name: terminal_path_kinds
doc: What each of `paths` is on disk — `0` missing, `1` a file, `2` a directory — so the terminal can make a path printed by a command clickable only when it names something real.

name: terminal_set_agent
doc: The window just typed `agent`'s CLI into session `id`: name it before the program has a chance to, so the card shows who is there from the first keystroke.

name: tickets_apply_reference
doc: The title and body with the reference applied — exposed for the form's "already there" check to be the same one the backend tests.

name: tickets_branch_name
doc: The branch «Empezar» would create, for the dialog to show (and let the user edit) first.

name: tickets_links
doc: What the links say for this workspace — DB only, so the projects panel can draw its chips without a request to any board.

name: tickets_list
doc: The tickets assigned to you on every connected board.

name: tickets_move
doc: «Mover a…», and undo of an automatic move: by the state's *name*.

name: tickets_on_pr_created
doc: A pull request was opened from `branch`: record it on the link, and move the ticket to review.

name: tickets_on_pr_merged
doc: The pull request from `branch` merged (seen by the app's own merge): move the ticket to done.

name: tickets_pr_reference
doc: What the PR form adds for a branch started from a ticket — `None` for any other branch.

name: tickets_start
doc: Creates the ticket's branch in a worktree of its own (or reopens the one it already has), records the link, and returns the first prompt.

name: tickets_sync
doc: Asks each linked pull request still open whether it merged meanwhile — on the host's website, from another machine — and moves its ticket to done if so.

name: autostart_enabled
doc: Whether CodeFlow starts when the user logs in.

name: hide_main_to_tray
doc: The main window's answer to the first-close notice: "keep it in the tray".

name: set_autostart
doc: Turns launch-at-login on or off and answers with what the system now says.

name: system_locale
doc: The operating system's locale (`es-CL`, `en-US`…), for the frontend's first-run language.

name: ts_notify
doc: A message tsserver never replies to — `open`, `change`, `close`, `updateOpen` — or replies to only with events: `geterr` and `geterrForProject`.

name: ts_request
doc: A request that expects an answer.

name: ts_start
doc: Starts the server for a repository, reusing the one already running for it — or, for a project on TypeScript 7, starts nothing and says where its own language server is (see the module note).

name: voice_fit
doc: The machine, every listener's and voice's fit, and the picks.

name: voice_measure
doc: «Medir»: runs `id` here on a synthetic utterance (a listener) or sentence (a voice) and stores it.

name: voice_clone_accept_terms
doc: The user accepting (or withdrawing from) XTTS v2's licence — non-commercial use only.

name: voice_clone_prepare
doc: Installs a cloning engine, its progress line by line on `voice:clone`.

name: voice_clone_record_finish
doc: Stops the recording and holds it; how long it was, in seconds.

name: voice_clone_record_start
doc: Starts recording the reference on `device` (`""` = the system's default).

name: voice_clone_save
doc: Makes a voice from the held recording.

name: start_watching
doc: The calling window's own claim, and only that — the holder is derived from the webview's label (see [`watcher::window_holder`]), so the main window and a detached repository window watching the same r

name: attention_open
doc: Opens the «Te necesitan» window (or brings it forward).

name: focus_satellite
doc: Brings one to the front.

name: get_quick_ask_shortcut
doc: The stored preference, resolved.

name: list_satellites
doc: Every satellite currently open.

name: open_satellite
doc: Opens the window for one app or one repository, or focuses the one already showing it.

name: quick_ask_close
doc: Destroys the ask box, webview and all.

name: quick_ask_open
doc: What the hotkey, the tray item and the frontend all call.

name: quick_ask_take_draft
doc: What Codi left for the ask box, once — `None` when Codi asked for nothing.

name: register_quick_ask_shortcut
doc: Binds (or rebinds) the system-wide chord that raises the ask box.

name: restore_satellites
doc: Puts back the desk [`close_all`] parked, and answers with how many windows came back.

name: set_window_unsaved
doc: A window saying whether it holds unsaved work — the satellites' half of [`close_all`]'s rule.

name: show_main_window
doc: Puts the main window back on screen, from a window that is not it.

name: unregister_quick_ask_shortcut
doc: Drops the system-wide chord, leaving the ask box reachable from the tray and the palette only.

name: worklog_generate
doc: Collects the period's work and writes the summary.
